## Supported bundle tool catalog

This appendix is the complete curated bundle inventory, not a claim that every
CTAN package belongs in one preamble. **Core** tools normally belong in the
matching profile. **Conditional** tools are supported when their named job
appears. **Alternative** tools replace a selected system. **Exception** tools
require a tested external workflow or viewer. **Excluded** tools are recorded
so an agent does not select them accidentally.

### Workflow, engine, and typography

| Tool | Status | Job |
|---|---|---|
| Quarto | Core | Own `.qmd` profiles, citations, code blocks, cross-references, and multi-format rendering. |
| Pandoc | Core through Quarto | Transform the document model into article or Beamer LaTeX. |
| LuaLaTeX | Core | Compile Unicode text and OpenType mathematics; required for graph drawing. |
| `latexmk` | Conditional | Drive repeated raw-LaTeX compilation outside Quarto. |
| `fontspec` | Core with LuaLaTeX | Select OpenType or TrueType text fonts. |
| `unicode-math` | Core with LuaLaTeX | Select Unicode mathematics and provide `\symbf`. |
| `microtype` | Core for articles | Improve protrusion, expansion, and spacing. |
| `xcolor` | Core | Define semantic colors for figures, links, and callouts. |
| `geometry` | Conditional | Set author-controlled article, report, or thesis margins. |
| `setspace` | Conditional | Meet an explicit line-spacing requirement. |
| `fancyhdr` | Conditional | Add headers and footers when the class does not own them. |

### Mathematics, quantities, and chemistry

| Tool | Status | Job |
|---|---|---|
| `mathtools` | Core | Extend AMS mathematics environments and symbols. |
| `derivative` | Core when derivatives appear | Keep ordinary, partial, material, and higher derivatives consistent. |
| `siunitx` | Core | Typeset values, units, ranges, uncertainty, scientific notation, and numeric columns. |
| `amsthm` | Conditional | Define theorem, definition, assumption, and proof environments. |
| `thmtools` | Conditional companion | Define declarative theorem styles and lists. |
| `nicematrix` | Conditional | Annotate block Jacobians, Hessians, stoichiometric matrices, and bordered arrays. |
| `cancel` | Teaching only | Expose canceled terms in instructional derivations. |
| `bm` | Alternative | Bold traditional math fonts when `unicode-math` is not the selected architecture. |
| `mhchem` | Core chemistry syntax | Typeset formulas, phases, charges, reactions, and equilibrium arrows. |
| `chemfig` | Conditional | Draw document-native two-dimensional molecular structures. |
| `chemnum` | Conditional | Assign stable labels to repeatedly discussed compounds. |
| `chemmacros` with `chemformula` | Alternative | Replace the chemistry syntax when broader chemistry conventions are required. |

### Tables and retained values

| Tool | Status | Job |
|---|---|---|
| `booktabs` | Core | Use restrained horizontal rules and whitespace. |
| `threeparttable` | Core when notes exist | Keep caption, table, and notes at one width. |
| `pgfplotstable` | Selected | Format the same retained tables used by PGFPlots. |
| `longtable` | Conditional | Continue a table across pages. |
| `multirow` | Conditional | Group repeated row categories. |
| `makecell` | Conditional | Make compact multiline headers and cells. |
| `csvsimple` | Conditional | Filter CSV rows or generate repeated LaTeX content. |
| `pdflscape` | Conditional | Rotate a wide table page with correct PDF orientation. |
| `tabularray` | Alternative | Replace the traditional stack for complex author-controlled tables. |

### Figures, process diagrams, and reusable sources

| Tool | Status | Job |
|---|---|---|
| `graphicx` | Core | Include, crop, scale, and rotate reviewed external graphics. |
| TikZ | Selected | Draw semantic schematics, geometry, workflows, and process concepts. |
| PGFPlots | Selected | Render modest retained tables with document-matched axes and typography. |
| `standalone` | Conditional | Compile a reusable TikZ or PGFPlots source independently. |
| `adjustbox` | Conditional | Constrain or crop reviewed content without repairing bad source geometry. |
| `chemplants` | Conditional | Supply simplified process-flow equipment symbols. |
| `chempid` | Conditional | Supply P&ID symbols after checking the project convention. |
| `circuitikz` | Conditional | Draw electrical instrumentation, sensors, and control hardware. |
| `forest` | Conditional | Draw compact rooted model or solver hierarchies. |
| `schemabloc` | Existing-source exception | Maintain an established control block diagram. |
| `svg` | External-tool exception | Import SVG through a controlled Inkscape conversion route. |

### Built-in TikZ libraries

| Library | Status | Job |
|---|---|---|
| `arrows.meta` | Core for directed paths | Select modern, consistently sized arrow tips. |
| `positioning` | Core for node diagrams | Place named nodes relative to one another. |
| `calc` | Conditional | Express offsets, interpolation, and projections from named coordinates. |
| `fit` | Conditional | Draw a boundary around an explicit node set. |
| `backgrounds` | Conditional | Put regions behind paths and nodes. |
| `matrix` | Conditional | Build regular node grids and stage arrays. |
| `chains` | Conditional | Build a repeated ordered sequence. |
| `intersections` | Conditional | Compute a geometric intersection that belongs to the diagram. |
| `decorations.markings` | Conditional | Add repeated arrows or markers along a path. |
| `decorations.pathmorphing` | Conditional | Draw restrained coils, waves, or irregular boundaries. |
| `patterns.meta` | Conditional | Add grayscale-safe material or region patterns. |
| `shapes.geometric` | Conditional | Use a conventional geometry or decision shape. |
| `graphs` | Conditional | Declare compact graph syntax with manual layout. |
| `graphdrawing` plus `layered,trees` | Conditional | Automatically lay out a larger directed graph with LuaLaTeX. |
| `external` | Performance exception | Cache measured expensive figures through a controlled build. |

| Library | Status | Job |
|---|---|---|
| `ext.positioning-plus` | Selected | Place or span nodes relative to multiple bounding boxes. |
| `ext.paths.ortho` | Selected | Route explicit orthogonal streams and signals. |
| `ext.node-families` | Conditional | Stabilize shared dimensions across related nodes. |
| `ext.layers` | Conditional | Put a node or path on a named layer. |
| `ext.arrows-plus` | Conditional | Place or bend arrow tips on complex paths. |
| `ext.paths.arcto` | Conditional | Construct a true geometric arc-to path. |
| `ext.topaths.arcthrough` | Version-gated | Test its exact path syntax against the installed TikZ release. |
| `ext.scalepicture` | Version-gated exception | Test its keys before using auxiliary-file picture scaling. |
| `tikzmark` | Selected | Anchor an overlay to prose, equations, or table cells. |

### Lists, code, algorithms, drafting, and Beamer

| Tool | Status | Job |
|---|---|---|
| `enumitem` | Article conditional | Tune author-controlled list labels and spacing. |
| Quarto highlighting | Core in `.qmd` | Highlight fenced source code without a LaTeX code package. |
| `listings` | Selected raw-LaTeX route | Typeset portable code without an external highlighter. |
| `minted` | Alternative exception | Use a resolved external highlighter for trusted source. |
| `algorithmicx` plus `algpseudocode` | Selected | Typeset adaptable pseudocode. |
| `algorithm2e` | Alternative | Replace the selected pseudocode system with an integrated float style. |
| `tcolorbox` | Conditional | Create breakable examples, definitions, and teaching callouts. |
| Git plus `latexdiff` | Selected review route | Generate a review copy from committed source states. |
| `lineno` | Review only | Add requested manuscript line numbers. |
| `changes` | Manual-review exception | Record explicit source markup when collaboration requires it. |
| `todonotes` | Draft only | Keep visible author tasks out of final output. |
| Moloch | Selected Beamer theme | Provide the restrained presentation profile. |
| `appendixnumberbeamer` | Conditional | Exclude backup frames from the main frame count. |
| `pdfpc` | Conditional | Add PDF Presenter Console notes and metadata. |
| `animate` | Tested-viewer exception | Embed frame animation only after rehearsal on the exact viewer. |
| Poppler `pdftotext` and `pdftoppm` | QA dependency | Extract text geometry and render final PDF pages. |
| MuPDF `mutool` | QA dependency | Trace stroked vector paths for text-to-drawing clearance checks. |
| ImageMagick `montage` | QA conditional | Build document-flow contact sheets when requested. |
| `latex_visual_qa.py` | Release gate | Check text-to-text and text-to-vector clearance, render color and grayscale pages, and write a JSON report. |

\newpage

### Deliberately unselected tools

| Tool | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `tikzscale` | $\enspace$ Excluded | Set explicit source dimensions or use `standalone`; preserve text size. |
| `tikzplotlib` | $\enspace$ Excluded | Retain data and use the selected Matplotlib or PGFPlots route. |
| `gnuplottex`, `\addplot shell`, direct `\write18` | $\enspace$ Excluded | Keep computation in the analysis environment and the build reproducible. |
| `smartdiagram` and `pgf-pie` | $\enspace$ Excluded | Use semantic TikZ or a chart tied to the scientific question. |
| novelty shape collections | $\enspace$ Excluded | Project semantics, not decoration, should select shapes. |
| `tikz-3dplot` | $\enspace$ Not a default | Use 3-D only when it clarifies a relation that 2-D cannot. |

## Quick examples for high-value tools

### Quantities, chemistry, and derivatives

```{=latex}
\[
  \qty{4.70}{\bar},\qquad
  \num{1.23(4)},\qquad
  \ce{CO2 + 2 RNH2 <=> RNHCOO- + RNH3+},\qquad
  \pdv{C_A}{t}
\]
```

### A restrained scientific table

```{=latex}
\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{@{}l S[table-format=2.1]@{}}
\toprule
Stream & {Flow / \si{\kmol\per\hour}} \\
\midrule
Feed & 12.2 \\
Product & 10.8 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}
```

### Relative TikZ geometry and an orthogonal signal

```{=latex}
\begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=8mm]
\node[cse tool] (sensor) {sensor};
\node[cse tool,right=of sensor] (controller) {controller};
\draw[cse signal] (sensor.east) r-rl (controller.west);
\end{tikzpicture}
```

### Retained values rendered by PGFPlots

```{=latex}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[cse axis,xlabel={Volume / \si{\meter\cubed}},ylabel={Conversion}]
\addplot[cse model] table[x=volume,y=model,col sep=comma]
  {data/reactor-profile.csv};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
```

### Molecular and process abstractions

```{=latex}
\chemfig{CH_3-CH_2-OH}
\qquad
\ce{CH3CH2OH + 3 O2 -> 2 CO2 + 3 H2O}
```

Use `chemplants` for Figure 2's unit-operation vocabulary, `chempid` for
Figure 3's P&ID symbols, `circuitikz` for its sensor analogue, and `forest` for
Figure 4's model hierarchy. Those source files are reusable examples rather
than fragments duplicated here.

### Quarto owns the two output profiles

```yaml
format:
  pdf:
    pdf-engine: lualatex
    include-in-header: tex/article-preamble.tex
```

The Beamer target changes `pdf` to `beamer`, selects `theme: moloch`, and loads
the smaller Beamer header. Shared notation and figures stay in common source.

## Agent lookup and QA resources

The repository guidance in `references/latex-layout-and-qa.md` defines label
zones, connector clearance, bounding-box padding, profile-width checks, log
inspection, and full-size raster inspection. The searchable local official
manual cache is built with `scripts/cache-latex-manuals.sh` and indexed at
`~/.local/share/cse/latex-manuals/INDEX.md`.

The release order is source review, real Quarto build, log review, automated
visual QA, full-size manual inspection, and a recorded disposition. Automated
success never certifies path crossings, schematic truth, or scientific claims.

```bash
python3 scripts/latex_visual_qa.py builds/article.pdf \
  --profile article --output-dir builds/visual-qa/article --contact-sheet
```
